transcript: At the end of 2019, in Wuhan, China, a new virus was discovered. Within a few weeks, it had spread across borders to the rest of the world. In March 2020, the World Health Organization declared it a pandemic. Countries imposed lockdowns and schools and many businesses were closed. Infected patients were taken to hospitals across each region. Intensive care units quickly filled up. Doctors and nurses worked without regard to their own risk Symptoms differed from one person to another Fever, cough and shortness of breath were common Most cases were mild by elderly people And those with existing diseases became seriously ill more easily Researchers developed a vaccine at an unprecedented speed Within just over a year, several vaccines were approved And vaccination began throughout the world The pandemic has left us many lessons How vital public health preparedness is How without international cooperation Infectious diseases cannot be stopped To prepare for the next crisis We must not forget these lessons

segments.text: At the end of 2019, in Wuhan, China, a new virus was discovered.
Within a few weeks, it had spread across borders to the rest of the world.
In March 2020, the World Health Organization declared it a pandemic.
Countries imposed lockdowns and schools and many businesses were closed.
Infected patients were taken to hospitals across each region.
Intensive care units quickly filled up.
Doctors and nurses worked without regard to their own risk
Symptoms differed from one person to another
Fever, cough and shortness of breath were common
Most cases were mild by elderly people
And those with existing diseases became seriously ill more easily
Researchers developed a vaccine at an unprecedented speed
Within just over a year, several vaccines were approved
And vaccination began throughout the world
The pandemic has left us many lessons
How vital public health preparedness is
How without international cooperation
Infectious diseases cannot be stopped
To prepare for the next crisis
We must not forget these lessons
